title: Billing Transaction Recorded
description: A Mercury webhook command was handled: the ledger now holds Mercury's current state of what the delivery named, either because this batch's ms tx sync read it (synced; code set when an autotag or a Farm push failed after the sync committed) or because an earlier read that began at least 5 s after the delivery arrived already covered it (covered, carrying that read's batch_id and read_at). Carries the command_id, batch and read window; never an amount, a counterparty, a note or a category. id = uuid5(NS_MERCURY_HOOK, command_id + ':' + type). Ordered by ledger:global (AAI's bank is no client's). Emitted by milkshake-farm-consumer. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (billing, transaction) and Milkshake docs/farm-commands.md 16.7.6.
